title: data for machines.set
description: Pick the machines of one task (J-05 worker-machine-0811): the coordinator machine, the worker machines, or one role slot's machine (role + machine together). Fields left out keep their stored value (else the defaults: coordinator main, worker_machines [main]); a slot pick that is no longer one of the workers is dropped. Machine ids come from src/machines.mjs (main, spare, laptop). The coordinator may seed a task but never overwrite the owner's pick (409 owner_set).
